summary: Implementation plan for upgrading the Collaborative Whiteboard Studio with FigJam/Notion/Figma UI & interactions (tactile bottom dock, floating node context bar, interactive edge connector handles, pinned canvas comment threads, live cursor chat, and stamp wheel), Dual-Layer Supabase Database + Late-Joiner Peer State Persistence & Version History, and Deep Cross-Platform Integration (Live Co-Whiteboard stage inside Video & Audio Calls, Team Chat interactive board cards, Project Docs/Task embedding, and 1-Click Follow Teammate Viewport).
